title: The Dish
tagline: The moon landing, live from a sheep paddock.
about: A radio telescope in a sheep paddock in Parkes helps broadcast the 1969 moon landing.
cue: Serve the snacks when the first pictures come through from the moon.
faces: Ration sheet. Hot, filling and plenty of it.
Plain buttery scones baked packed close so they rise tall.
Scone dough rolled up with yeast spread and tasty cheese, sliced and baked.
Mayor's roast lamb cutlets and mint sauce
Roast lamb racks carved into cutlets.
Crisp meringue round topped with whipped cream and passionfruit.
The whole town watching the moon landing.
Lemon and lime syrup, soda and cold lager, with a lemon wedge.
Best glassware, out for the ambassador's visit.
Form LAB1969, rev. 2000. Return tray to the hatch. Rations subject to supply.
